title: Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2021
short_title: Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2021

speeches.speaker: Pat Conroy
speeches.brief: The bill updates the Major Sporting Events Protection Act to replace references to the 2018 Commonwealth Games and postponed 2020 T20 World Cup with the FIFA 2023 Women's World Cup and the 2022 T20 World Cup, while also amending the Sport Integrity Australia Act to correct World Anti-Doping Code article numbers. The speaker moved an amendment calling on the government to implement a national quarantine system for COVID-safe travel of sports teams and officials.

speeches.speaker: Bert van Manen
speeches.brief: The Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2021 protects sponsorship rights and prevents ambush marketing for the ICC T20 World Cup 2022 and FIFA Women's World Cup 2023, while removing protections for past events. Global sports sponsorship fell from $65 billion in 2019 to $17.2 billion in 2020 due to COVID-19.

speeches.speaker: Patrick Gorman
speeches.brief: The Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection Bill 2021 was supported, citing Australia's sporting history and the 2021 AFL Grand Final in Perth, which added $50 million to the WA economy. The government was urged to improve promotion of events and consider hosting the 2027 Special Olympics in Perth.

speeches.speaker: Angie Bell
speeches.brief: The speech supported the Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2021, which extends anti-ambush marketing protections to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023 and ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022, with protections ending on 31 December 2024 and 13 November 2023 respectively. The speaker also highlighted Gold Coast tourism’s pre-pandemic $6 billion value, federal grants including $1.5 million for Surfers Paradise’s cancelled Springtime event, and the region’s role in the 2032 Olympics.

speeches.speaker: Joanne Ryan
speeches.brief: The speaker supported the Major Sporting Events (Indicia and Images) Protection and Other Legislation Amendment Bill 2021, which updates dates and adds new events. They highlighted the importance of sport for community and youth, praised netball and women’s cricket, and advocated for netball’s inclusion as an Olympic sport in Brisbane.

speeches.speaker: Sussan Penelope Ley
speeches.brief: The bill adds the FIFA Women's World Cup 2023 and ICC T20 World Cup 2022 to the list of protected major sporting events to prevent ambush marketing, removes protections for the 2018 Commonwealth Games, and corrects a reference in the Sport Integrity Australia Act.
